upstream.identity_scope: Upstream project references, not proof that these local bytes match an official release.

provenance.origin_basis: Existing import record: extracted from a user-provided Desktop resources/app.asar, under drawio/src/main/webapp. VERIFY-01 did not independently repeat or authenticate that extraction.
provenance.independent_official_comparison: Not performed against an official release archive/tarball or a pinned upstream commit. Neither the original Desktop artifact identity nor correspondence to official 29.7.9 release bytes has been independently verified.

hash_verification.method: Node.js crypto.createHash('sha256') over fs.readFileSync raw file bytes; lowercase hexadecimal, with no decoding, newline normalization, decompression, or minification.
hash_verification.path_base: archify/editor/vendor/drawio, relative to the repository root
hash_verification.coverage: All 13 payload files in this directory tree are listed in files; SOURCE.json is metadata and is excluded from its own hash list.
hash_verification.result: 13 of 13 listed hashes match; no payload bytes or recorded digest values changed in VERIFY-01.
recompute_powershell_from_repository_roo: foreach ($entry in $manifest.files.PSObject.Properties) { $actual = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $vendor $entry.Name) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($actual -cne $entry.Value) { throw ('SHA-256 mismatch: ' + $entry.Name) }; Write-Output ('MATCH ' + $entry.Name + ' ' + $actual) }
